proof.description: Layout block for the header proof-stat row. Set top-level "blocks": {"proof": "<block-id>"} to one of the listed ids; omit for the default.

table.description: Layout block for the comparison table.

faq.description: Layout block for the FAQ section.

verdict.description: Layout block for the closing verdict box.

risk.description: Optional risk-reversal microcopy under the header CTA (design-skills A4). Copy is a verified claim; never a guarantee the tenant does not offer.

tagline.description: Optional large-type two-line benefit statement after the header (design-skills B11).

eyebrow.description: Literal '<A> vs. <B>' naming the run's product and the compared subject, e.g. 'Model A vs. Model B' for {{ tenant.name }}'s own lineup. Never a competitor name the tenant forbids.

headline.description: 8 words or fewer; a literal repeat or plain reframe of the eyebrow. No hype, no unsourced superlative.

subhead.description: One value-prop sentence naming what the comparison decides.

proof_stats.description: Optional 2-3 stat proof row under the subhead -- verified claims only, each with claim_ids. Omit entirely rather than pad.

comparison_table.description: The sourced spec table. Every cell is {text, claim_ids} with at least one claim id from facts_pack.verified_claims -- the gate rejects any cell without one. Rows come from the compared subject's own rows in facts_pack.comparison_targets.

columns.description: Column labels: the spec dimension first, then the run's product, then the compared subject.

cells.description: One {text, claim_ids} per column after the first. claim_ids is required on every cell.

deep_dives.description: 2-4 sections, one per dimension the run's product wins on.

alternative_strengths.description: Honest strengths of the alternative -- 2-4 entries, each a real sourced fact (claim_ids required). Compare on facts, never disparage. (The list field is named 'strengths', not 'items' -- 'items' collides with a dict's own .items method under Jinja's attribute-then-subscript lookup.)

verdict.description: The bottom line: who should pick which, then the same CTA once more.

risk_reversal.description: Optional 1-2 line microcopy under the header CTA, rendered through the risk-reversal block -- verified claims only (e.g. the fixed warranty sentence); never a guarantee the tenant does not offer.

tagline.description: Optional two-line benefit statement after the header, rendered through the tagline-reveal block (design-skills B11).

images.description: 2-4 images from the asset library, referenced by asset_id only.

cta_text.description: The ONE CTA button text for this page, from allowed_cta_texts -- rendered in the header and the verdict box, verbatim both times.

cta_url.description: The CTA's destination URL, reused everywhere cta_text is.

blocks.description: Optional layout-block picks per slot (see block_slots); omit to render the defaults.
